scope: exact geometry at one fixed AR20 pose; no Stokes solve

geometry.normal_orientation: out of solid, into exterior fluid

interpretation: Signed error=(exact vertical gap-2h)/(2h) on .5*x^T*H*x=h. Outside either projected silhouette the two-surface vertical gap is undefined. Finite-angle maxima are sampled geometric errors, not hydrodynamic error bounds.
